meta.name: verification-before-completion
meta.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交前自动运行验证命令并确认结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在提交或创建PR前需要强制验证测试通过
copy.tagline_en: Run verification commands and confirm output before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce verification before committing or creating PRs

howto.what: Claude 在声称工作完成、测试通过或准备提交代码前，必须先运行验证命令并检查输出，否则不能做出任何成功断言。
howto.when: 当你要说“完成”、“通过”、“修复”等表示成功的话，或准备提交代码、创建 PR 时触发。

say.text: 运行测试并告诉我结果。
say.note: Claude 会执行测试命令并报告通过/失败。
Claude 会运行构建命令并检查退出码。

say.text: 验证这个 bug 是否真的修复了。
say.note: Claude 会运行重现步骤并确认修复。

howto.what_en: Before claiming work is complete, tests pass, or code is ready, Claude must run verification commands and check output; no success claims without fresh evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when about to claim success, completion, or before committing/creating PRs.

say_en.text: Run the tests and show me the results.
say_en.note: Claude will execute test command and report pass/fail.
Claude will run build command and check exit code.

say_en.text: Verify this bug is actually fixed.
say_en.note: Claude will run reproduction steps and confirm fix.
